text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, apixaban 5 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East has 131 tablets on hand with 8.7 tablets used per day, providing 15.1 days of supply. Corvale General has 274 tablets on hand with 10.5 tablets used per day, providing 26 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include apixaban as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 15 to 26 days depending on site. Two ranked purchasing options are available from suppliers not on the FDA shortage list. One product label identifies MSN Laboratories Private Limited in Telangana, India as the manufacturing plant for an apixaban product labeled by Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with E.R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C. as the primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify and place orders with Indoco Remedies Limited as the secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Pharmacy director to monitor daily usage and inventory levels at both sites; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. P&T committee to review supply status at next scheduled meeting; requires committee chair approval.

Not recommended: No allocation, therapeutic substitution, or conservation measures at this time.
